text:
Hannah W.: Kicking off FjordMart onboarding. Pilot: 6-week in-store assistant + receipts parser. Need owners, success signals (business + ML), timeline, and any renewal risk triggers.

Eliot M.: I'll own infra + deployment. Ask: cross-account read role OR daily S3 dump with PII redacted. Need sample product SKUs and taxonomy for intent mapping.

Priyanka K.: I'll run enablement and success criteria. Suggest business metric: reduce CS AHT on checkout queries by >=30% during pilot. Also need adoption goal: 5 internal demos and 2 exec reviews.

Omar (FjordMart): We can provide masked receipts and SKU mapping. Security flagged GDPR retention rules for EU customers; Marco will join security sync.

Hannah W.: Stakeholders: FjordMart - Omar (product), Marco (security), Lin (ops). Redwood - Hannah (CS), Eliot (Infra), Priyanka (Enablement), Noor (ML backup).

Eliot M.: Infra plan: staging VPC + 2-GPU test pool. ETA: endpoint + cert by Thu. I'll post an endpoint + small cURL smoke test here.

Priyanka K.: Draft success criteria (combined):
- Business: CS AHT drop >= 30% on target flows OR pilot endorsement email from 2 product managers
- ML: intent accuracy (top-1) >= 90% on labeled set; extraction accuracy for totals/dates >= 92%
- Perf: p95 latency < 800ms under expected load (10 RPS)
- Ops: JSON schema v1 validated >= 94%
- Adoption: 2 enablement sessions, feedback avg >= 4/5, 5 internal demos

Omar (FjordMart): Important: GDPR means we can only share EU receipts with explicit consent. We'll provide mixed-region masked exports. If delayed we'll accept synthetic dataset.

Hannah W.: Security sync requested. Marco, can you do Tue 11am PT? Need to review data flow, retention, and deletion policy.

Omar (FjordMart): Tue 11am PT works. We'll prepare a short doc about retention windows.

Eliot M.: Quick infra note: we'll enable request-level tracing and a fallback routing policy to smaller models if latency spikes. Also will set up cost cap alerts.

OnboardBot: Reminder created: "FjordMart security sync" scheduled for 2024-04-09 11:00 UTC. Link: https://meet.redwood.ai/meet/fjord-449

Priyanka K.: Timeline (proposal):
- Week 0: access + staging endpoint (Eliot)
- Week 1: baseline eval + 2 enablements (Noor/Priya)
- Week 2-3: iterate prompts + integration tests
- Week 4: pilot run + internal demos
- Week 5-6: exec review + renewal convo prep

Hannah W.: Owners & immediate actions:
- Eliot: endpoint + presigned S3 guide by Thu (owner)
- Noor: request 200 labeled examples or confirm synthetic fallback by Mon
- Priyanka: schedule enablement sessions and draft feedback form by EOD
- Omar: confirm SKU taxonomy upload + GDPR redaction plan by EOD

Eliot M.: Will post cURL when live, sample: curl -s -X POST https://staging.redwood/fjord/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' -d '{"input":"where's the nearest store open now"}'

Priyanka K.: Renewal risk flags: if we miss enabling internal demos by week 4 or if ML accuracy < threshold by week 3, flag for executive sponsor touchpoint. I'll add an escalation step in the runbook.

Hannah W.: Great. Reconvene Fri 10am PT to confirm infra + dataset. Thanks all :sparkles:

OnboardBot: Thread summary saved to #cs-playbooks (FjordMart onboarding).
